title: Dig World Grapevine: Construction Adventure Park Admission Ticket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Dig World Grapevine is the only place in DFW where guests can operate real Caterpillar construction equipment - no simulators, no substitutes. Designed for all ages, the experience is equally engaging for kids and adults, all backed by world-class service and hospitality that elevates every visit.
